description: This file defines the LeaveProfileNode class within the Twig profiler extension. It represents a node used during template profiling to indicate when a profiling scope is left, encapsulating the logic for compiling this into executable PHP code.

classes.name:
Twig
ode\LeaveProfileNode
classes.description: Represents a profile leave node used in Twig's profiling system. It extends the base Node class and is responsible for emitting the PHP code to denote the end of a profiling scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the node with a variable name that is used during profiling to identify the scope.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates the PHP code to leave the profiling scope, inserting appropriate calls to the profiler's leave method.
